_about: Hand labels for the body gate: would a weekly J&T Express Germany report carry
this item? Labelled by reading the full stored body, before any model saw it.
Keyed by URL; bodies stay in the database. 'unsure' means either gate verdict is
acceptable, so scoring counts misses on 'relevant' and keeps on 'irrelevant'.
Results of the gate runs against these labels are in
docs/selection_and_assessment.md. Some URLs are no longer selected (the UPS and
BPEX fixes of 2026-09-11); their labels stay valid as ground truth.

samples.round1: 30 at random (seed 20260911) from the 748 bodies profile 2026-09-11 selected, news and regulatory together
samples.round2: 30 news bodies with a brand or topic match (seed 20260912, pool 167), 15 regulatory bodies the selector picked and 15 it skipped (seed 20260913, pools 50 and 335); profile 2026-09-11.2; round-1 URLs excluded

rules.news: relevant = a weekly J&T Express Germany report could carry it (parcel/KEP market, couriers, postal law; customs, duties, import, product-safety or platform rules for e-commerce imports; a competitor or customer as a business). unsure = touches that area only indirectly. irrelevant = accidental keyword match or general logistics/HR/IT/corporate. Labelled by reading the full body, before any model call.
rules.regulatory: relevant = a new or changed rule, decision, enforcement action, consultation or official figure on postal/parcel law and the parcel market; customs and import tax on e-commerce parcels; product safety and market surveillance of imported goods; rules and enforcement on online marketplaces; packaging/returns rules for e-commerce shipping; competition cases on carriers or platforms; trade measures hitting e-commerce imports. unsure = horizontal rules that apply to J&T as to any company, or a digest where the relevant part is minor. irrelevant = other sectors, consumer advice, organisational news, speeches without a relevant decision. Labelled by reading the full body, before any model call.
